I graduated from Master of Science in Business Analytics (MSBA) program at the University of California, Irvine, with a strong focus on data-driven decision making and applied machine learning.

I have experience building end-to-end analytics and AI systems, including a semantic search and RAG pipeline for medical literature and predictive models for e-commerce user behavior. My work emphasizes translating data into actionable business insights, from improving customer targeting to optimizing operational decisions.

I am particularly interested in roles such as Business Analyst, Data Analyst, Consultant, and Operations or Inventory Analyst, where I can leverage data to support strategic decision-making and drive measurable business impact.
